verdict.rationale: Kimi publishes a real public API with OpenAPI specs: chat completions, responses, Anthropic-compatible messages, batches, files and models, plus an Admin API for org/key/billing management. The vendor explicitly says file Q&A from the assistant is matched by the API. However, the probe finds no public API for the Kimi assistant app itself, and the API is a separate Open Platform product, so most assistant UI features have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: API equivalents for agent mode/Agent clusters, deep research, PPT assistant, web-building/deploy, scheduled tasks, memory, and plugins/skills, plus any stated UI–API parity commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Kimi intelligent assistant can upload files and answer questions based on those files. The Kimi API offers the same functionality.
The Kimi Admin API lets organization administrators manage members, invitations, projects, and inference API keys programmatically, and query billing, usage, and audit logs
